svg.title: Within-host foot-and-mouth disease virus dynamics by strain, recomputed
svg.desc: Panel a: log10 viral load over 30 days for SAT-1, SAT-2 and SAT-3, recomputed from the published within-host model at each strain's median parameters; SAT-1 peaks highest and earliest, SAT-2 lowest, SAT-3 latest. Panel b: the adaptive immune response over the same period; in this median-parameter simulation SAT-1 rises first, SAT-2 next, and SAT-3 rises last to the lowest plateau. Panel c: the strain-level transmission rate against the median host replication rate, with the host range as a horizontal bar, for the three strains; both increase from SAT-3 to SAT-2 to SAT-1. Panel d: per-host infectious period against adaptive activation rate from the paper's host table, decreasing with activation rate.
